name: screenconnect-mcp-server
description: MSP-safe MCP server for ConnectWise ScreenConnect via the RESTful API Manager extension.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to ConnectWise ScreenConnect using the ConnectWise Labs RESTful API Manager extension secret (no admin passwords required). Defaults to read-only mode with code-enforced read / write / destructive tiers, session group allowlists, dry-run previews, and audit logging.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify ScreenConnect reachability and CTRLAuthHeader authentication.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List ScreenConnect sessions with structured filters (name, group, onlineOnly, offlineOnly, OS, user).

tools.name: search_sessions
tools.description: Search ScreenConnect sessions by structured fields or raw GetSessionsByFilter expression.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Fetch a single normalized session by GUID via GetSessionBySessionID.

tools.name: get_session_details
tools.description: Fetch detailed session telemetry, network addresses, and custom properties.

tools.name: get_session_events
tools.description: Fetch recent session events with readable eventTypeName.

tools.name: get_server_info
tools.description: Inspect active server mode, enabled tiers, and allowlist status.

baseUrl.title: ScreenConnect Base URL
baseUrl.description: HTTPS base URL of your ScreenConnect instance (e.g. https://control.example.com).

apiSecret.title: RESTful API Manager Secret
apiSecret.description: RESTfulAuthenticationSecret configured in the ConnectWise Labs RESTful API Manager extension (sent as CTRLAuthHeader).

mode.title: Safety Mode
mode.description: Execution tier: read (default, read-only) or write (adds notes, messages, rename, custom properties). Destructive mode requires explicit CLI/env configuration.

allowedGroups.title: Allowed Session Groups (optional)
allowedGroups.description: Comma-separated full session group paths to scope access (e.g. All Machines/Contoso). Leave empty for all groups.

origin.title: Allowed Origin Header (optional)
origin.description: Optional Origin header if RESTfulAllowedOrigin is configured in the extension settings.
